definitions.full: H5573. Senneh סֶ֑נֶּה proper name rup. (= thorny , compare GASm Geogr. 250 n. HPS on the passage ); — a cliff opposite the cliff called בּוֺצֵץ 1Sam 14:4 (Ginsb as here; Baer סֵ֑נֶּה , van d. H. סֶ֑נֶה ); ᵐ5 Σεννααρ .
